claim_boundary: The repository-local G1 contract tranche, Admin governance, and real 1.7B smoke are accepted for continued development. They are not a G1 certificate. A 1.7B unsigned developer asset, WSL telemetry, one physical laptop, nominal capacity, and source inspection do not substitute for signed 4–6B packs, both physical A1 boards, complete security/manual/performance evidence, or the real 400–405B experiment.

items.subject: checked-resource-ledger-and-fake-inference
items.observations: 22 focused resource/fake-inference tests passed; the final validation record covers all 98 declared tests in native Windows and Ubuntu WSL with zero failures.

items.subject: state-export-restore-migration-and-retention
items.observations: The state-transfer and core target run passed 14 tests after schema migration 2 was added.

items.subject: policy-dag-platform-model-pack-and-local-gateway-contracts
items.observations: The implementation commit passed all 98 declared repository tests in both native Windows and Ubuntu WSL, with platform-specific skips recorded in the final validation record. The unit suite does not establish production key custody, physical-board qualification, or a certified model tuple; real model observations are recorded separately.

items.subject: host-and-gpu-telemetry-adapter
items.observations: Three deterministic adapter tests passed, followed by a read-only adapter smoke against WSL host RAM and the observed RTX 3050. No model was loaded, so this does not prove allocation enforcement, inference, isolation, performance, recovery, or a service class.

items.subject: admin-role-delegation-and-policy-mutation-boundary
items.observations: Focused Admin and policy tests passed for finite role/activity assignment, revocation/expiry, hash-linked receipts, non-delegable Admin semantics, and authorization of policy mutations. This is not production signing custody.

items.subject: real-low-parameter-local-model-smoke
items.observations: The pinned Qwen3-1.7B Q4_K_M artifact produced exact direct and authenticated Luma-gateway smoke responses with llama.cpp b11100 on native Windows CUDA and Ubuntu WSL CPU. The real gateway path used checked resource admission, a short-lived scoped policy grant, and no remote fallback. Both environments used the same physical laptop. The model is below the governed 4–6B range and the developer asset is not a signed certified model pack.

closure_rule: Development may proceed under the explicit deferral record. Formal G1 may be marked passed only when formal G0 dependencies are resolved and every G1 exit criterion has retained current-revision evidence on the required real environments.
